method.method_draft: First describe the image: the board has four positions arranged as a square cycle, with Home H at top-left, School S at top-right, Park P at bottom-right, and Library L at bottom-left; the neighbour connections are H-S, S-P, P-L, and L-H. Use the text to note that the kangaroo starts at S, must first land on H exactly on jump 13, and cannot continue after landing on H. Count H-avoiding prefixes of length 12 by dynamic programming on the non-home positions S, P, L. Let s_t, p_t, l_t be the number of ways to be at S, P, L after t jumps without having landed on H. Start with (s_0,p_0,l_0)=(1,0,0). For t<12, moves to H are forbidden, so the recurrences are s_{t+1}=p_t, p_{t+1}=s_t+l_t, l_{t+1}=p_t.
